page.overview:
Who is Lita Luwanda?

Lita appears in several chapters of the American 1995 Street Fighter cartoon series under the name of Celia. Her appearance is noticeably different in the cartoon, being brunette with a gray uniform instead of blonde in a green uniform. Though being longtime allies, she is shown to be jealous of Burke's open infatuation with Cammy, which further sours into full blown vitriole after the latter is revealed to be a sleeper agent working under Bison.
